title: A Novel Information-Theoretic Objective to Disentangle Representations for Fair Classification

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating disentanglement by measuring the accuracy of an adversarial classifier trained from scratch to predict the inferred race (e.g., non-Hispanic black or non-Hispanic white) of the author from the model's latent text representations, alongside calculating the GAP fairness metric.

Evaluating disentanglement by measuring the accuracy of an adversarial classifier trained to predict the author's binned age group (under 35 vs. over 45) from the learned latent text representations, and calculating the GAP fairness metric.

Evaluating disentanglement by measuring the accuracy of an adversarial classifier trained to predict the author's gender from the learned latent text representations, and calculating the GAP fairness metric.
